edges.label: ▶ orders.order-placed.v1
edges.description: orders.order-placed.v1 starts the workflow at reserve-stock

edges.label: ✓ inventory.stock-reserved.v1
edges.description: Success: inventory.stock-reserved.v1 moves from reserve-stock to charge-payment

edges.label: ✕ inventory.out_of_stock
edges.description: Failure: inventory.out_of_stock at reserve-stock leads to Compensating

edges.label: ↻ 2× on timeout
edges.description: Retry: reserve-stock is retried 2× when it times out

edges.label: ⏱ PT5M
edges.description: Timeout: after PT5M reserve-stock leads to Compensating

edges.label: ✓ payments.payment-captured.v1
edges.description: Success: payments.payment-captured.v1 moves from charge-payment to review-large-order

edges.label: ↻ 3× every PT10M on payments.declined
edges.description: Retry: charge-payment is retried 3× every PT10M on payments.declined

edges.label: ✕ payments.declined
edges.description: Failure: payments.declined at charge-payment leads to Compensating

edges.label: ✕ payments.fraud_suspected
edges.description: Failure: payments.fraud_suspected at charge-payment leads to Compensating

edges.label: ↻ 2× on timeout
edges.description: Retry: charge-payment is retried 2× when it times out

edges.label: ⏱ PT2M
edges.description: Timeout: after PT2M charge-payment leads to Compensating

edges.label: ✓ orders.order-approved.v1
edges.description: Success: orders.order-approved.v1 moves from review-large-order to create-shipment

edges.label: ⤼ unless $data.amount > 5000
edges.description: review-large-order is skipped to create-shipment unless $data.amount > 5000

edges.label: ✕ orders.order-rejected-by-review.v1
edges.description: Failure: orders.order-rejected-by-review.v1 at review-large-order leads to Compensating

edges.label: ⏱ P1D
edges.description: Timeout: after P1D review-large-order leads to ManualIntervention

edges.label: ✓ shipping.shipment-created.v1
edges.description: Success: shipping.shipment-created.v1 moves from create-shipment to Completed

edges.label: ✕ shipping.address_invalid
edges.description: Failure: shipping.address_invalid at create-shipment leads to await-address-fix

edges.label: ↻ 3× exponential from PT5M on timeout
edges.description: Retry: create-shipment is retried 3× exponential from PT5M when it times out

edges.label: ⏱ PT1H
edges.description: Timeout: after PT1H create-shipment leads to ManualIntervention

edges.label: ✓ orders.address-corrected.v1
edges.description: Success: orders.address-corrected.v1 moves from await-address-fix to create-shipment

edges.label: ⏱ P2D
edges.description: Timeout: after P2D await-address-fix leads to ManualIntervention

edges.label: ⟲ nothing to undo
edges.description: Compensation: nothing to undo, the workflow is compensated
